summary: Iteration 26 (security hardening + EasyPost tracking) fully verified. 19/19 backend pytests pass covering: (a) old admin password 'MonsterAdmin2026!' → 401 + new ADMIN_PASSWORD from env → 200 admin role; (b) POST /api/auth/demo-login {artist} → artist role, {collector} → buyer role, {admin} → 422; (c) login rate limits: 10 per-email fails then 11th → 429 with valid Retry-After header, per-email isolation (a different email still logs in), successful login clears the counter (5 fails → success → 5 more fails all stay 401); (d) 2FA email flow: setup+enable via injected code hash, resend 3× ok / 4th → 429, verify-login 8 wrong codes → 429 with Retry-After, then decayed twofa_fail_at (20 min ago) → next attempt 401 'Wrong code' (not 429); (e) html.escape on delivery_confirm_html/gift_ticket_html/refund_email_html — raw <b>/<script> stripped, <b> present; (f) CSV formula injection guard — attendee row with name '=HYPERLINK("x")' comes back prefixed with a single quote in the events analytics.csv; (g) tracking manual mode: /api/tracking/config live_tracking:false webhook_configured:false carriers[19+], /api/orders/order_testA1/tracking as demo collector 200 live_tracking:false, unrelated user 403, POST /api/tracking/easypost/webhook 503 (no secret); (h) regression: full ship→carrier-delivered→pending→mark-delivered flow on a fresh test order. Frontend Playwright confirmed both /login one-tap demo buttons call /api/auth/demo-login and route correctly (artist→/studio, collector→/dashboard) and /orders/order_testA1 for the demo collector renders live-tracking-panel + manual-tracking-note ('Live tracking isn't connected yet…') AND the delivery-confirm-modal ('Did your order arrive?'). Rate_limits collection was cleared at test-start and test-end.
critical_code_review_comments: twofa.verify_login: fails counter is $inc'd on wrong code but never bounded — after 8 fails you 429 correctly, but the counter keeps climbing on repeated attempts inside the lockout window. Harmless (guard checks fails>=8) but consider capping to avoid unbounded int on abuse.

auth.login: hit() is called on both ip_key and email_key after a bad-password 401, but check() runs BEFORE hit(). Result: exactly 10 fails succeed with 401, 11th is 429 (correct per contract). However on 2FA-enabled accounts, a successful password with wrong device token still returns 200 requires_2fa — that 200 does NOT clear the ip_key counter (only email_key is cleared). Acceptable but note: someone brute-forcing a 2FA account will exhaust the IP bucket via bad passwords only.

tracking.easypost_webhook: relies on easypost.util.validate_webhook and returns 401 on any exception — good. However on missing 'result' the function 200-'accepted:True,matched:False' — a malformed but signed event will still be recorded in webhook_events. Consider not inserting the event_id row until after match to avoid dedupe-poisoning by an attacker with a valid signature.

delivery.mark_carrier_delivered: send_email is awaited without try/except. If Resend raises (sandbox non-owner recipient can silently fail via emails.py fallback, but any hard raise would 500). emails.send_email already swallows exceptions so this is fine — flagging as informational, not a bug.

events.py _SafeWriter guards str cells starting with =, +, -, @, tab, CR — good. Missing: control chars inside a cell (e.g. leading NUL) and Unicode look-alikes (fullwidth '＝'). Excel treats those as text so likely safe; noting for defence-in-depth.
